comparison.objective: Insert and lock a hose nipple in a quick-connect coupler; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Retract a collar, insert one coaxial nipple, and release the pawl versus align two-prong interfaces at two separated posts while supporting and extending a rail.
comparison.success_condition: Requires seated nipple, returned collar, release, and optional pull confirmation; candidate requires handed orientation, matched front/rear rack units, four prongs, screws, and load-bearing release.
comparison.reason: The coupler is a single-axis lock; the candidate tests distributed alignment and structural attachment.
